summary: No exact residential destination plus 10–20 nonduplicative applicable courses, traditional A/B/C transcript proof and at least 50% applicable transfer was established. Sophia pass/fail and MyPath mastery do not become letter grades through partnerships. Preserve existing mappings and student history; retain WATCH with no speculative new pathway.
